design: Every candidate is applied independently to the unchanged model document. Two one-word substitutions and two one-sentence structural edits per document.

candidates.rationale: Test a common synonym in a fixed description of the analytical method.
candidates.preservation_notes: Content analysis retains the same primary status; the cross-sectional independent measures design is unchanged.

candidates.rationale: Test a shorter contrast marker while leaving the ranking-versus-behaviour claim intact.
candidates.preservation_notes: Retains the contrast with the previous finding and the qualification did not appear; it does not assert that the rankings definitively failed to correspond.

candidates.old: Farmer-level variables examined included the specific BVD control measures adopted, livestock disease priorities, reasons for scheme membership, wider knowledge acquisition, biosecurity practices and training course attendance.
candidates.new: The study examined farmer-level variables including the specific BVD control measures adopted, livestock disease priorities, reasons for scheme membership, wider knowledge acquisition, biosecurity practices and training course attendance.
candidates.rationale: Make examined the main verb, replacing the reduced relative clause before included.
candidates.preservation_notes: Preserves farmer-level scope, the nonexhaustive including construction, every listed variable and the same study as the implied investigator; no first-person voice is introduced.

candidates.old: The findings therefore indicate that disease control efforts, although necessary, are insufficient on their own.
candidates.new: The findings therefore indicate that disease control efforts are insufficient on their own, although they are necessary.
candidates.rationale: Move the concession out of the subject-predicate span, so the main conclusion is read continuously.
candidates.preservation_notes: Preserves the evidential verb indicate, inferential therefore, necessity of disease control and its insufficiency when used alone.

candidates.rationale: Test a common determiner in place of a formal adjective while keeping the sentence structure fixed.
candidates.preservation_notes: Both forms require the same adequacy of evidence; the criticism, uncertainty, threat reduction and biodiversity outcomes remain unchanged.

candidates.rationale: Test an ordinary synonym for an abstract noun without changing its grammatical role.
candidates.preservation_notes: The same approach remains under discussion, with the same purpose of protecting very rare species; no effectiveness claim is added.

candidates.old: Projects that adopt this strategy are frequently criticized for failing to provide sufficient evidence that they have reduced threats or improved the status of the biodiversity they seek to protect.
candidates.new: Projects adopting this strategy are frequently criticized for failing to provide sufficient evidence that they have reduced threats or improved the status of the biodiversity they seek to protect.
candidates.rationale: Reduce the opening relative clause to a participial modifier; leave the evidence clause and every outcome unchanged.
candidates.preservation_notes: The same projects remain the subject. Frequency of criticism, sufficiency of evidence, alternative conservation outcomes and intended protection are preserved.

candidates.old: Over four years, we conducted monitoring guided by a theory of change to evaluate assumptions about the links between intermediate results and biological outcomes.
candidates.new: Guided by a theory of change, we monitored for four years to evaluate assumptions about the links between intermediate results and biological outcomes.
candidates.rationale: Use the verb monitored directly and move its methodological qualification to the front.
candidates.preservation_notes: Preserves the authors as actors, four-year duration, theory-of-change guidance, evaluative purpose, assumptions and both levels of outcomes.

candidates.rationale: Test a common continuation verb without changing the claim about rural-urban inequalities.
candidates.preservation_notes: Both variants assert continuing inequalities in access to and use of health facilities; neither changes their scope or magnitude.

candidates.rationale: Test a close scientific-register synonym while holding the recommendation and sentence structure fixed.
candidates.preservation_notes: Retains the requirement for enough knowledge of structural constraints and health inequities; the target population, location and future initiatives remain identical.

candidates.old: This study explored the perceptions and decision-making processes of women and their communities during childbirth in rural Sierra Leone.
candidates.new: In rural Sierra Leone, this study explored the perceptions and decision-making processes of women and their communities during childbirth.
candidates.rationale: Put the study location first and shorten the sequence of modifiers at the sentence end.
candidates.preservation_notes: Retains explored, both perceptions and decision-making processes, women and their communities, childbirth timing and the rural Sierra Leone setting.

candidates.old: The findings showed that decisions during childbirth emerge through dynamic, complex processes that must be understood within the wider social context in which they occur.
candidates.new: The findings showed that decisions during childbirth emerge through dynamic, complex processes that must be understood in their wider social context.
candidates.rationale: Replace the final embedded relative clause with a possessive context phrase to reduce nesting.
candidates.preservation_notes: Retains the reported finding, childbirth timing, dynamic and complex processes, the necessity of understanding them contextually, and the wider social scope.
